notes: Soak test of the live path (experiments/2026-11-13-m6-13-soak; plan.md committed before the run, 10 criteria). Chain: BrainFlow Synthetic bridge (restart every 30 min, kill/clean, one 3-s dropout per life) -> LSL -> toy signal decoder (features/flat alternate) -> StreamingTrustLayer (incremental demo decoder, M4-09 GC rule, shadow CTC beam + CharNgramLM LRU 20,000) -> trust_decision on LSL -> consumer validating every event. Main run 6.78 h (stopped from outside at 20:47, cause unknown), 6,067 decisions: 7/10 pass (0 COMMIT, 0 invalid, 0 lost, 14/14 gaps, 26 reconnects, push p95 worst window 1.76 ms, EOU p95 <= 10 ms, e2e p95 55 ms); FAIL C2 memory (+16.9 MB/h private) and C9 clock (3 windows at 1,373 ms transport), C1 (outside kill). Bug 1: guard used the shared 200,000-entry cached_edit_distance memo (about 30 pairs, 22 KB per decision; idle GC 0.8 -> 8 ms) -> own guard_edit_distance (4,096). Bug 2: Windows stepped the wall clock -1,361 ms; the bridge used one wall-to-LSL offset from start, so stamps stayed 1.36 s late (forward step: false gap) -> offset measured each read, step handled (stats.clock_steps). Post-fix run 2.5 h, 2,242 decisions: 10/10 pass (private +0.80 MB/h, push p95 worst 0.75 ms, transport p50 11.2 ms flat). Tests: test_guard_cache_bound.py (3), test_brainflow_bridge.py (+3). Follow-ups: full-length post-fix run; resolve on reconnect blocks the loop up to 6 s; RefCharLM memo has no bound (slow growth, about 1 MB).
